description: Twarabiye hamwe ingene Daniyeli yasobanuriwe ivyo yeretswe kuko vyamuteye kudatahura. Umumalayika Gaburiyeli niwe yatumwe ngo asobanurire Daniyeli ivyo yeretswe. Daniyeli yari yeretswe impfizi y'intama hamwe n'impfizi y'impene . Twabonye ko impfizi y'intama yerekana abami b' Ubumedi n'Ubuperesi. Impfizi y'impene y'ibisambi Daniyeli yeretswe yagereranywa n'umwami w'Ubugiriki. Twarabonye kandi ko ihembe rinini ryo kuri ya mpene ryagereranywa n'umwami wa mbere Alexandero mukuru. Agahembe gatoya nako yari Antiyokasi Epifane hanyuma muri kazoza azoba ari antikristo. Antiyokasi Epifane yahamye abera b'Insumbavyose ariko inganji yiwe izokomborwa n'inganji ya Yesu Kristo.
name: Ahera ha mbere cari ikigereranyo c'ahera ho mw'ijuru

description: Twarabiye hamwe inyifato y'umwami Dariyo umumedi. Twabonye kandi ukuntu abaganwa n'abandi bagiriye ishari Daniyeli bamurega ibitari vyo kugira bamwicishe . Ninaco gituma yaterewe mu gwobo rw'intambwe ariko intambwe ntizamurya kuko umumalayika w'Imana yaciye aja kuzibira uminwa y'intambwe. Umwami Dariyo yaranezerejwe no kubona Daniyeli ataco yabaye.
name: Akaga ko guheba Imana

description: Twarabiye hamwe Daniyeli yatura ivyaha vy'ubwoko bwabo. Daniyeli mugusenga yifatanije n'Abisirayeli bacumuye ku Mana . Yavuze ngo twaracumuye vyumvikana ko nawe yarimwo . Abisirsyeli bari mu gihugu c'inyagano bagize ivyago vyinshi n'amarushwa ivyo vyabaye kuko bari bacumuye ku Mana . Daniyeli abonye ivyo yikubise imbere y'Imana yatura ivyaha vyabo kimwe ku kindi kugira ngo Imana ibagirire imbabazi . Twabonye ko umukristo akwiye kwatura icaha yakoze akakidomako urutoke.
name: Akamaro k'amaraso ya Kristo

description: Twarabiye hamwe inzozi za Daniyeli , muri izo nzozi Daniyeli yeretswe ibikoko bine navyo bikaba vyari ibi: intambwe ,idubu, ingwe n'ikindi kini atashoboye kumenya. Ivyo Daniyeli yabonye muri izi nzozi vyasa n'igishushanyo yabonye mu nzozi ziwe nkuko twabibonye mu gice ca kabiri c'iki gitabu ca Daniyeli. Twabonye ko umutwe w'izahabu wa kuri ca gishushanyo ca Nebukaniza wagereranijwe n'intabwe Daniyeli yeretswe mu nzozi, intambwe nayo ikaba yerekana ubwami bw'IBabuloni.Amaboko y'ifeza yagereranijwe n'idubu nayo ikaba yerekana ubwami bw'Abamedi n'Abaperesi.Twabonye kandi kuri ca gishushanyo Nebukadineza yerekwa inda n'ibibero vy'imiringa vyagereranywa n'ingwe mu nzozi Daniyeli yeretswe nayo ikaba yerekana ubwami bw'Ubugiriki na Makedoniya. Mu gishushanyo ca Nebukadineza twabonye ko amaguru yari ivyuma, ibirenge navyo cari ikivange c'ivyuma n'ibumba, mu nzozi za Daniyeli ibi vyagereranywa n'igikoko atamenye mugabo kikaba ca gereranywa n'ubwami bw'i Roma.
name: Amasezerano Y'Imana atera ivyizigiro

description: Twarangije igitabo c'uwavugishwa n'Imana Daniyeli , tubonye ingene Daniye yeretswe ivy'igihe c'iherezo.
name: Daniyeli abwirwa ivy'amarushwa ahambaye

description: Twarabiye hamwe uguhezagigwa kw'igishushanyo c'izahabu umwami Nebukadineza yari yahagaritse. Muguhezagira ico gishushanyo abatumiwe bose bategerezwa kwikubita hasi bagasenga ico gishushanyo bumvise amajwi y'inzamba n'ibindi vy'umuziki vyavuzwa. Twabonye ko umwami yashinze igihano gikomeye ku bantu bose batazokwikubita hasi ngo basenge ico gishushanyo c'izahabu ariko abasore batatu b'Abaheburayo ntibikubise hasi ngo bagisenge kuko ijambo ry'Imana rivuga ngo ntugasenge izindi mana n'ayandi majambo akurikira.
name: Ico Imana igomba ku bantu bayo bumva ijambo ryayo

description: Twarabiye hamwe amatariki n'ikibaza Daniyeli yerekewemwo umuntu w'ubwiza bukayangana. Daniyeli yeretswe uwo muntu mu mwaka wa 534 imbere ya Yesu Kristo kuvuka. Uwo muntu w'ubwiza bukayangana yamweretswe ari ku ruzi runini rwitwa Hidekeri. Daniyeli mukwitegurira ukwo kwerekwa yamaze amayinga 3 yisonzesheje. Twabonye kandi ko ivyo Daniyeli yeretswe vyazanye ingaruka kuri we kuko yaciye azimira ubwenge ahinda n'agashitsi. Mukurangiza, twabonye intumwa yo mw'ijuru yazaniye ubutumwa Daniyeli mugabo ntiyashobora kumenya iyo ntumwa.
name: Ikimazi Kristo yatanze kiruta ibimazi vyose vya Mose

description: Twarabiye hamwe ugusenyuka k'ubwami bw'abanyamahanga n'ishingwa ry'ubwami bwo mw'ijuru ngaha kw'isi. Twabonye ko Yesu Kristo ariwe azoganza ubwo bwami kandi ubwo bwami bwiwe buzokwamaho ibihe bidashira. Twararabiye hamwe kandi igishushanyo umwami Nebukadineza yakoze, twabonye n'ibituma bitatu(3)vyatumye akora ico gishushanyo: 1- yagomvye kugarariza Imana, 2 -yagomvye kwigira Imana ubwiwe, 3- yagomvye gufatanya canke gushira hamwe amoko y'abantu yari mu bwami bwiwe.
name: Ingene Kristo aruta Mose

description: Twarabiye hamwe ukuntu Daniyeli yashoboye gusoma inyandiko y'igikonjo ku gisika c'uruhome. Twabonye kandi ingene yayisobanuriye umwami Belushaza. Mu ncamake iyo nyandiko yavuga ko Belushaza ukeweko ubwami kuko aticishije bugufi. Yashizwe k'umunzane w'Imana asanga ntakwiye kubw'ivyo ubwami bwiwe bwagabuwemwo kabiri , bumwe buhabwa Abamedi ubundi buhabwa Abaperesi nawe aricwa.
name: Ingene Kristo yatubereye umuherezi mukuru

description: Twarabiye hamwe ivy'igikoko kigira kane Daniyeli yeretswe. Igikoko kigira kane Daniyeli yeretswe , cari igikoko atashoboye kumenya cari gifise amahembe icumi , cari gitandukanye n'ibindi bikoko vyari vyacitangiye imbere cari igikoko rero kidasanzwe kandi giteye ubwoba . Naho kitamenyekanye cagereranywa n'amaguru y'ivyuma n'ibirenge vy'icuma n'ibumba vyari kuri ca gishushanyo ca Nebukadineza yerekwa. Muvyo Daniyeli nawe yeretswe kuri iki gikoko cagereranywa n'ubwami bw'Ubu Roma. Daniyeli yeretswe kandi ukuza kw'umwana w'umuntu aza ava mw'ijuru mu bicu.
name: Ingene Melekisedeki ari umuherezi ahambaye

description: Twarabiye hamwe intahe ya Nebukadineza. Nebukadineza abonye ko abo yatereye mw'itanure ry'umuriro badapfuye yaciye ashingira intahe Imana y'Abayuda isumba imana ziwe. Nebukadineza kandi yarose izozi z'igiti c'inganza marumpu gihambaye kw'isi.
name: Ingorane zashikiye Ab'Isirayeli kubera kutumvira Imana

description: Twabonye Daniyeli yerekwa ivy'impfizi y'intama n'impfizi y'impene . Twabonye ko iyo mpfizi y'intama yari ifise amahembe abiri nayo yagereranywa n'ubwami bw'Abamedi n'Abaperesi. Iyo mpfizi y'intama yari ifise amahembe abiri atangana. Twabonye ko impfizi y'impene Daniyeli yeretswe yagereranywa n'ubwami bw'Ubugiriki.Iyo mpfizi y'impene yari ifise ihembe ry'akaranga bwami. Iyo mpene yaje idakoza amguru hasi ikubita hasi ya mpfizi y'intama irayisiribanga. Twarabonye kandi ko hari agahembe gatoya kandi kagereranywa na Antiyokisi Epifane uwahamye Abayuda agahumanya ingoro y'Imana i Yerusalemu.
name: Isezerano risha riruta irya kera

description: Twabandanije kurabira hamwe ukuntu Ubuyuda bwasubiye inyuma no gusenyuka kw'I Yerusalemu. Twabonye kandi ingene Daniyeli yafashe ingingo yokuba imvugakuri ku Mana mu kutarya indya umwami w'I Babuloni yaryako. Daniyeli na bagenzi we bahindurwa amazina yabo y'igiheburayo bitwa ay'ikinyamahanga. Daniyeli na bagenzi we naho bari mu gihugu c'inyagano i Babuloni bahagarariye Imana banka kwihumanisha ivyo kurya vyo ku kirimba c'umwami.
name: Ivy'icubahiro ca Kristo

description: Twarabiye hamwe ukuntu Nebukadineza yanezerejwe n'umubiri mwiza wa Daniyeli na bagenzi biwe . Twabonye kandi Nebukadineza asaba abanyabwenge bose b'Ibabuloni ngo bamubwire inzozi yarose.Nta munyabwenge numwe yashoboye kumubwira izo nzozi ziwe .
name: Ivy'icubahiro gihambaye ca Kristo

description: Twrabiye hamwe insobanuro y'inzozi z'umwami Nebukadineza. Daniyeli yasobanuriye uwo mwami inzozi ziwe . Munsobanuro yamuhaye, twabonye ko ubwami bwa Nebukadineza bwari bukomeye cane mbere ubwami buzokurikira ubwami bwiwe buzoba buto. Twarabonye ubwami butandukanye buzogenda bukurikirana ubwami bwa Nebukadineza bumaze gusenyuka. Ubwo bwami n'Ubumedi n'Ubuperesi , Ubuguliki na Makedoniya. Twabonye kandi ubwami bugira kane buzoba mu gihe c'iherezo. Ikindi twabonye n'ugusenyuka ku bwami bw'isi bw'abanyamahanga n'ishingwa ry'ubwami bwo mw'ijuru ngaha kw'isi.
name: Ivy'icubahiro gikomeye ca Kristo

description: Twabandinije kurabira hamwe intahe ya Nebukadineza. Yashingiye intahe Imana y'Abayuda ko ari'Imana isumba vyose. Twabonye kandi izindi nzozi z'igiti c'inganzamarumpu Nebukadineza yeretswe . Ayo majambo yose yadushikanye kukumenya ko Imana yamumenyesheje ko igororotse kandi ko ukuganza kwose kuva kuri yo.
name: Ivy'uburuhukiro bw'Imana

description: Twarabiye hamwe Daniyeli ambwira umwami inzozi ziwe n'ingene zisobanugwa. Daniyeli yamenyeshe umwami ko mu nzozi ziwe yabonye igishusho kinini gikayangana mugabo giteye ubwoba. Umutwe waco wari izahabu nziza, igikiriza n'amaboko navyo vyari ifeza, inda n'ibibero vyaco vyari imiringa, amaguru y'ivyuma, ibirenge vyari ikivangi c'ivyuma n'ibumba. Ico gishushanyo cari kigizwe n'ibice vyinshi vy'icuma igice cose caserukira ubwami.
name: Ivy'ukwezwa

description: Twrabiye hamwe ivy'antikristo, twabonye ko antikristo azokwishira hejuru akigira imana. Uyo antikristo azokwigira imana asaba ko isi yose imusenga nk'Imana nzima . Twabonye kandi ko azoganza amahera yose canke ubutunzi bwose bwo kw'isi. Abantu benshi rero bazomushwarako cane cane abo bibiliya yita "Aribuwa n'abanyetiyopiya . Twabonye ko mu gihe antikristo azoba aganza isi yongera agenzura n'ubutunzi bwose bw'isi nta muntu azoshobora kugura canke gushora ikintu adafise ikimenyetso mu kiganza c'ukuboko kw'iburyo canke mu ruhanga rwiwe . Twabonye ko azomara igihe gito kuko azosenyurwa n'ukuza kw'Umwami Yesu Kristo
name: Ivy'uwo antikristo

description: Twarabiye hamwe intangamarara y'igitabu c'uwavugishwa n'Imana Daniyeli. Twabonye ko Daniyeli ari igitabu kimwe gihambaye mu bitabu vyo muri Bibiliya , twabonye kandi ko kigabuwemwo ibice bibiri, kimwe kivuga ivy'akahise ikindi kivuga ivy'ubuhanuzi. Inyigisho nkuru y'Ubuhanuzi ivugwa ni Yesu Kristo. Daniyeli yari umuntu w'imigabo kandi yari umuntu asenga kandi w'umuhanuzi. Igitabu ca Daniyeli n'urufatiro rwo gutahura ibindi vyanditswe
name: Kristo n'agaheta

description: Twarabiye hamwe igiti c'inganzamarumpu umwami Nebukadineza yaronse. Yaciye ahamagaza Daniyeli ngo azimusobanurire . Daniyeli yamusobanuriye ko ico giti c'inganzamarumpu ari Nebukadineza ubwiwe nyene hanyuma kizocibwa mugabo igishitsi n'imizi vyaco bisigare. Nebukadineza azokugwa mu bwami bwiwe agende mw'ishamba arishe nk'ibikoko kumara inyaka ndwi (7).Igihe ca genywe kigeze, yatatse Imana isumba vyose ubwenge bwiwe buca buragaruka yongegwa inkomezi abandanya arongora ubwami bwiwe.
name: Kristo n'umuherezi wacu mukuru aruta Aroni

description: Twarabiye hamwe ivy'umunsi mukuru Belushaza yari yateguriye abaganwa biwe. Muri uwo munsi mukuru , Belushaza yabonye intoke z'Imana zandika ku gisika c'inzu. Iyo nyandiko nta munyabwenge numwe w'I Babuloni yashoboye kuyisoma uretse Daniyeli . Umwami yahaye ingabire Daniyeli kuko yashoboye gusoma iyo nyandiko hanyu Daniyeli nawe arayanka. Daniyeli yibukije Belushaza ivyabaye kuri sekuruza Nebukadineza .
name: Kristo niwe muherezi wacu mukuru aruta Abalewi

description: Twarabiye hamwe ukuntu Abaheburayo batatu ba basore banse kwikubita hasi ngo basenge igishushanyo igishushanyo umwami Nebukadineza yari yahagaritse. Umwami yaciye ashinga icagezwe ko batererwa mw'itanure ry'umuriro. Bamaze guteregwa muri iryo tanure ntibapfuye kuko Imana yarabakingiye. Ikindi nuko Nebukadineza yatereye mw'itanure ry'umuriro abantu batatu gusa ariko haciye akanya yabonyemwo uwundi agira kane kandi uwo wa kane yarafise ishusho y'umwana w'Imana. Mu kurangiza, Nebukadineza yaciye ashinga icagezwe c'uko abantu bose bakwiye kwubaha Imana y'Abaheburayo amaze kubona ubugene yari imaze kubakiza mw'itanure ryaka umuriro.
name: Ntitugire umutima mubi w'ukutizera

description: Twakomeje kwumva Daniyeli yerekwa umuntu w'ubwiza bukayangana . Twabonye umuntu yamenyesheje Daniyeli intambara zizoba hagati ya Egiputa na Siriya.
name: Ntitwiyonjorora

description: Twakomeje kwumva intumwa yarungitswe guha inyishu Daniyeli y'amasengesho yiwe. Iyo ntumwa yari yarungitswe na Kristo kandi yoba yari umumalayika Gabuliyeli kuko twabonye ko no mubindi bihe harungitswe we kwa Daniyeli. Twabonye kandi ingaruka kuri Daniyeli amaze kwerekwa umumalayika , Daniyeli yapfukamitse amavi hasi n'ibiganza ajugumira. Daniyeli muri ico gihe, yararemeshejwe kandi yongerwa inkomezi. Twarabonye ko umumalayika yazaniye inyishu Daniyeli mugabo mu nzira yahasanze ibigoranye , yasanze hazibiye . Ibi bisobanurwa ko hari intambara hagati y'abakozi ba satani n'abamalayika b'Imana igihe dusenga. Iyo ntambara rero, dutegerezwa kuyigwana no kuyitsinda twitwaje inkota ya mpwemu ari ryo jambo ry'Imana.
name: Twegereze ata bwoba

description: Twavuganye kuvy'amahembe cumi yari kuri ca gikoko ca kane Daniyeli yerekwa mu nzozi. Twabonye ko ayo mahembe cumi yagereranywa n'ubwami cumi buzoseruka buvuye mu bwami bw'Abaroma. Twabiye hamwe ivy'agahembe gatoya kari ku mutwe wa ca gikoko cagira kane . Ako gahembe gatoya twabonye ko ari antikristo azoseruka mu gihe c'ubwami bw'Abaroma. Uyo antikristo azonesha abami batatu, azohana n'abera b'Insumbavyose, azorogota ku Mana no kuri Kristo, azoganza imyaka itatu n'igice(3,5 ans) hanyuma Kristo azoza amukura ku nganji amuterere mu kiyaga caka umuriro hamwe n'abamukurikiye. Hanyuma Kristo azoca ashinga ubwami bwiwe ngaha kw'isi , ubwami butazoshira.
name: Ubuherezi bukuru bw'Umwami wacu Yesyu Kristo

description: Twarabiye hamwe isengesho rya Daniyeli n'inyishu yahawe. Daniyeli yasavye Imana kugirira imbabazi Ab'Isirayeli kuko bari mu gihugu c'inyagano aho bari bamerewe nabi. Daniyeli mu gusenga yifatanije nabo avuga ko bacumuye, ntaho dusoma ko Dfaniyeli yakoze icaha ariko mu gusenga yifatanije n'abantu biwe avuga ngo twaracumuye. Daniyeli yatuye ivyaha bakoze kimwe kimwe cose. Ikindi twabonye nuko Daniyeli akiriko arasenga inyishu yari mu nzira iriko iraza. Daniyeli yabwiwe ivy'amayinga mirongirindwi (70 semaines) . Ayo mayinga 70 yari imyaka 70 y'ibihe 7 n'ukuvuga rero imyaka 490. Mur'ayo mayinga 70 twabonyeko amayinga 62 amaze , kurangira ubu rero turi mw'iyinga ryanyuma aho turindiriye ukuza k'Umwami wacu Yesu Kristo.
name: Ubuherezi bukuru bw'umwami Yesu

description: Twarabiye hamwe insobanuro y'ibikoko bine Daniyeli yeretswe. Hanyuma kandi twarabiye hamwe igikoko kigira kane . Twabonye ko ico gikoko kigira kane cari igikoko giteye ubwoba kuko cari gifise amahembe cumi. Igikoko kigira kane cagereranywa n'ubwami bw'Aboroma. agahembe gatoya kari kuri ico gikoko kagereranywa na antikristo azoza gusubiza hamwe ubwami bw'ubwami bw'Abaroma. Uwo antikristo azohama ishengero ry'umwami ariko kandi Kristo azokiza amasigarira y'abiwe.
name: Ubuherezi bwa Yesu buruta ubw'Abayuda

description: Twarabiye hamwe ivy'intambara zari hagati ya Egiputa na Siriya . Twabonye ko Ab'Isirayeli bagize ivyago muri izontambara. Twarabonye ko Antiyokasi Epifane uwariwe , twabonye ko agereranywa na antikristo azoza mu gihe c'iherezo . Uyo Antiyokasi Epifane igihe yatera I Yerusalemu mu mwaka w'i 170 imbere y'ivuka rya Kristo, hapfuye Abayuda benshi barenga ibihumbi ijana. Twarabonye kandi amazina menshi atandukanye yitirirwa antikristo . Uyo antikristo azokwigira vyose , uw'intwaro n'uw'idini. Azokwigira imana kandi abantu benshi bazomusenga , ivyo azobikora mu kanya gato gusa hanyuma atsindwe n'Umwami wacu Yesu Kristo.
name: Ukwizera

description: Twarabiye hamwe insobanuro y'ibikoko bine Daniyeli yeretswe. Ibikoko bine Daniyeli yeretswe vyari : intambwe , idubu, ingwe n'ikindi gikoko atamenye. Ivyo bikoko bine vyagereranywa n'ubwami bune nyene bwagiye bukurikirana. Twabonye ko intambwe yagereranywa n'ubwami bw'i Babuloni canke umutwe w'inzahabu wari kuri ca gishushanyo Nebukadineza yarota. idubu nayo igereranywa n'ubwami bw'Abamedi n'Abaperesi canke amaboko y'ifeza yo kuri ca gishushanyo ca Nebukadineza . Ingwe nayo yerekana ubwami bw'Ubugiriki canke na Makedoniya canke amaguru y'umuringa kuri ca gishushanyo ca Nebukadineza . igikoko canyuma nticamenyekanye yamara cerekana ubwami bw'i Roma cagereranywa rero n'amaguru y'ivyuma n'ibirenge bivanze n'ibumba vyari kuri ca gishushanyo ca Nebukadineza .
name: Yesu n'umuherezi mukuru mu buryo bwa Melekisedeki
